sql.value: select t.tot,d.MID,d.PID,d.ANDROIDID from (select count(ID) as TOT,mid from master_replica_squeue group by mid) t inner join dispositivos_activos d on d.MID=t.MID left outer join (select max(FECHA) as FECHA,MID from mred_infolog.monitor_envio_push group by mid) p on p.MID=t.MID where (p.FECHA is null or p.FECHA < date_sub(sysdate(),INTERVAL 10 minute)) and t.TOT > 0 and d.PID is not null order by t.tot desc

sql.value: select O.NUMEROORDEN        from gen_ot_cabecera O INNER JOIN (select MAX(ID) AS ID,TASK_ID from gen_ot_estados         GROUP BY TASK_ID) E ON E.TASK_ID = O.TASK_ID         INNER JOIN gen_ot_estados ER ON ER.ID = E.ID         left join monitor_ot_pdf_generate m on IFNULL(O.AREA_EMPRESA,'') like concat(m.AREA_EMPRESA,'%')         and ifnull(m.CLASE_ACTIVIDAD,O.CLASE_ACTIVIDAD) like concat('%',O.CLASE_ACTIVIDAD,'%')         and ifnull(m.CLASE_ORDEN,O.CLASE_ORDEN) = O.CLASE_ORDEN         and ifnull(m.NO_CLASE_ACTIVIDAD,'')         not like concat('%',O.CLASE_ACTIVIDAD,'%')         and ifnull(m.NO_CLASE_ORDEN,'')         not like concat('%',O.CLASE_ORDEN,'%') WHERE ER.ESTADO IN (5)  and m.ID is not null         and m.PDF_PLANTILLA is not null and IFNULL(O.PDF_CREADO,0) = 0         and TIMESTAMPDIFF(minute,ER.FECHA,NOW()) >= 60
